one_off_payments.what: Purdue settlement of PRV sale claim, paid in two $2.0M installments (March and June 2024)
one_off_payments.quote: In February 2024, following discussions with Purdue, we agreed to pay Purdue $4.0 million in respect of its claim. We paid the first installment of $2.0 million in March 2024 and the second installment of $2.0 million in June 2024.
